node.title: The upper rank-eight interval reaches the dense-owner chronology terminal
node.closure: marked owner-pair averaging plus deficiency-sensitive fixed-owner multiplicity
node.statement: For every 22526<=K'<=37995, a surviving rank-eight fixed chart contains one actual owner pair that owns at least 200632 selected records and has core deficiency at most 4. At K'=22526 the marked demand exceeds 200631*C(n'-9,2) by 11714977255865, while at K'=22525 it falls short by 1170919108090. The average ratio is a constant times C(m',11)/C(n',11), hence increases. This reaches the exact dense-owner terminal imported from PR #1168 but does not assign chronology, coalesce owners, or pay rank eleven.
